1) Bank details: we typically prefer ACH (USD) but can do wire for first payment if required. Can you confirm whether Redwood requires a bank confirmation letter or if a micro-deposit/KYC stub is acceptable? Attaching our W-9 and a redacted bank stub for reference.

2) Invoice submission: do you require invoices emailed to a specific remit address, uploaded to a vendor portal, or routed via PO number in the subject line? If you prefer a dedicated remittance email (remit@redwood.com), please confirm format.

3) PO workflow: do you create POs for all orders or only for subscriptions/annual contracts? If you require a PO to trigger payment, please let us know how to include the PO number on our invoices.

4) Payment terms and exceptions: what are standard terms (Net 30/45/etc.) and who should we contact for early payment or ACH vs wire preference?

If it's easier, we can hop on a 15-min call tomorrow — otherwise a checklist works fine.

Hi Sam — great to meet you over email. Thanks for the docs. I pulled together our standard vendor intake checklist below to capture everything we need to get Greenbridge fully enabled and paid. If anything is missing we can adjust, but this will get us to a PO and first payment.

Redwood vendor enablement checklist (initial):
- Completed W-9 or equivalent tax form (we have yours attached)
- Bank account confirmation: we accept one of the following:
  • Bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead OR
  • Redacted bank statement with account name OR
  • Micro-deposit verification (we will send micro-deposits to confirm)
- Preferred payment method: ACH (recommended) or Wire (one-time/urgent)
- Remittance email for invoice submissions (see remit below)
- Invoice format: PDF, include invoice number, invoice date, PO number (if provided), line-level description
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (unless otherwise agreed in SOW/contract) — exceptions require approval from Finance Ops
- Contact for billing disputes and escalation (name/email)

Remittance and PO details:
- Remit email for vendor invoices: remit-invoices@redwood.com (please CC accounts-payable@greenbridge.com when you send initial invoices)
- If we issue a PO, please add PO# to the invoice header and the subject line of the email as: PO12345 — Invoice 1001

Next steps from our side:
- I will create a vendor record in our system and request micro-deposits to confirm the bank (unless you can provide a bank confirmation letter).
- Vanessa (cc'd) is on Finance Ops and will confirm whether we can accept the redacted bank stub for onboarding or if we should proceed with micro-deposits.
- Laura will kick off the PO process once the vendor record is created and we have the billing contact.

Can you confirm: 1) whether you prefer ACH or wire for the first payment, 2) the billing contact for escalation, and 3) whether you want us to send micro-deposits or if you can provide a bank confirmation letter?

If you prefer a quick call, I can book 15 minutes — otherwise reply with the three items and I'll proceed.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Manager, Vendor Enablement | Redwood Inference

Hi all — quick operational notes from Finance Ops: 

- Payment terms: default is Net 30. If Greenbridge requires Net 45/60 we will need a brief justification and approval from our FP&A partner; please flag this now if it's required.
- ACH vs Wire: ACH is preferred (lower fees) and is what we'll use for recurring payments. For first-time payments we can do a one-time wire if you indicate that in your reply; note wires may require beneficiary verification which can add ~2 business days.
- Bank verification: redacted bank statements are acceptable for low-risk vendors, but because this is a B2B healthcare vendor we will request micro-deposit verification by default unless we receive a bank letter on letterhead.
- PO issuance: Laura will issue a PO once the vendor record is in our system. We typically create POs for contract-based services and one-off SOWs; ongoing subscription fees may be billed without a PO depending on the contract.

Laura — please confirm expected lead time to issue PO after vendor creation.

Sam — if you can reply to Tessa with: preferred payment method (ACH/wire), billing contact (name/email/phone), and whether you'll provide a bank letter or accept micro-deposits, we can move this to "enabled" status.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
